The '''Dissuader KD-30''' was a highly specialized [[Slugthrower/Legends|slugthrower]] produced by [[Kelvarek Consolidated Arms/Legends|Kelvarek Consolidated Arms]] and used during the reigns of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. The weapon fired hollow slugs filled with [[Acid/Legends|acid]], which were capable of dissolving [[Armor/Legends|armor]], flesh and [[Bone/Legends|bone]]. KD-30s cost 350 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]], and needed to be reloaded every ten shots, firing to a maximum range of 100 [[Meter/Legends|meters]].

==Description==
The KD-30 slugthrower pistol was a small model of highly specialized [[Slugthrower pistol/Legends|slugthrower pistol]], which weighed 1.4 [[Kilogram/Legends|kilograms]].<ref name="AEG" /> With a range of 100 [[Meter/Legends|meters]],<ref name="GFT" /> it fired metal-coated slugs which were hollow and filled with borless [[Acid/Legends|acid]]. The contents of these projectiles would eat through any [[Armor/Legends|armor]] that it struck, as well as flesh and [[Bone/Legends|bone]]. Ten of these slugs could be fired before a KD-30 needed to be reloaded.<ref name="AEG" />

==History==
Produced by [[Kelvarek Consolidated Arms/Legends|Kelvarek Consolidated Arms]], the KD-30 required a permit to use and sold for 350 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]], with the ammunition costing 100 credits per ten slugs.<ref name="AEG" /> The weapons were available in the period following the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[1000 BBY/Legends|1000 BBY]],<ref name="Date">The ''[[Arms & Equipment Guide]]'' states that the earliest [[List of publishing eras|publishing era]] the pistols appear in is the [[Rise of the Empire era]], which according to the [[Star Wars Blog]] post "Eras of Adventure" by [[Leland Chee]], begins in the year 1000 BBY.</ref> during the reign of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], and continued to be used into the reign of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and later the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]].<ref name="AEG" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Dissuader KD-30 slugthrower pistol was designed for the ''[[Arms & Equipment Guide]]'', a supplement to [[Wizards of the Coast]]'s ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]''. The [[Book/Legends|book]] was released in [[2002]], written by [[Owen K.C. Stephens]] and [[Jeff Grubb]] with illustrations of the weapons by [[Chris Trevas]].
